SELECT * FROM [SYN].[STG_CRM_ACCOUNTS]
INSERT INTO [SYN].[STG_CRM_ACCOUNTS]
(
		[ACCOUNTID]
	,	[BANK_ID]
	,	[ORGKEY]
	,	[CUST_FIRST_NAME]
	,	[CUST_MIDDLE_NAME]
	,	[CUST_LAST_NAME]
	,	[SALUTATION]
	,	[CUST_DOB]
	,	[PLACEOFBIRTH]
	,	[NAMESUFFIX]
	,	[NAME]
	,	[STRUSERFIELD1]
	,	[ENTITY_CRE_FLAG]
	,	[SUSPENDED]
	,	[RECORDSTATUS]
	,	[CORE_CUST_ID]
	,	[BANK_CODE]
	,	[SOURCE_CODE]
	,	[TABLE_NAME]
	,	[FILE_NAME]
	,	[insert_dttm]
)
SELECT 
		[ACCOUNTID]
	,	[BANK_ID]
	,	[ORGKEY]
	,	[CUST_FIRST_NAME]
	,	[CUST_MIDDLE_NAME]
	,	[CUST_LAST_NAME]
	,	[SALUTATION]
	,	left(CONVERT(varchar, CUST_DOB, 112),6) [CUST_DOB]
	,	[PLACEOFBIRTH]
	,	[NAMESUFFIX]
	,	[NAME]
	,	[STRUSERFIELD1]
	,	[ENTITY_CRE_FLAG]
	,	[SUSPENDED]
	,	[RECORDSTATUS]
	,	[CORE_CUST_ID]
	,	[BNK_CODE]
	,	[SOURCE_CODE]
	,	NULL [TABLE_NAME]
	,	[FILE_NAME]
	,	[insert_dttm]
FROM 
	EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM WHERE SCD_END_DATE='9999-12-31'
